method: WebGL2 RGBA8 offscreen 1280x720, same four native scenes/uniforms, 24 interactions. Three alternating-order blocks per scene/variant; five warmup and thirty measured draws. One EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 query covers each thirty-draw block; elapsed time divided by thirty; disjoint blocks rejected. Also reports wall time for thirty draws plus one 1-pixel synchronous readback, divided by thirty (amortized submission/completion, not display FPS). Compilation, warmup, full-image readback, Playwright IPC, UI and vsync excluded.
status: Rejected: repeated opaque fullscreen draws completed only once do not establish distinct frame cost; tile/overdraw elimination is a plausible explanation for the approximately thirtyfold undercount.
